remarks: Move right in! Welcome to this fully renovated 2 bed 2 bath condo in the heart of downtown Greenwich. The whole unit has been recently updated including a brand new kitchen with custom cabinets, high end appliances, beautiful quartz backsplash/countertops and a newly added pantry. This large condo on the second floor has new hardwood floors throughout, custom window treatments, new lighting, new doors, custom closets and much more. Heated garage with one assigned parking space at $100/month. Additional parking spots are available upon request. 24/7 Doorman, concierge, one block from Greenwich Avenue, close to Whole foods and YMCA. All special assessments for this unit have been paid off by the owners.
